skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the principles and nature of risk and the role of insurance in risk management.
Grasp the principles, classification, and scientific basis of insurance.
Comprehend the concepts, characteristics, and implementation of social insurance programs.
Understand the concepts, characteristics, and implementation of health insurance programs.
Comprehend the concepts, characteristics, and implementation of unemployment insurance programs.
Understand the concepts, characteristics, and implementation of commercial insurance.
Understand the concepts, characteristics, and implementation of deposit insurance.
Apply knowledge of insurance principles to analyze and manage insurance operations.
Develop critical thinking and analytical skills in the context of insurance.
Demonstrate effective teamwork and leadership skills.
Improve presentation skills through group projects and seminars.
Enhance research skills through independent and group projects.
